_comment: Extensions offered by the web installer. src is relative to python/ in the repo, dest is the path on the watch. A dest that matches a core file overrides it. module is the name written to extensions.json on the watch (it must expose register(api), see python/screens.py). To add an extension: drop its files under python/extensions/<id>/ and add an entry here -- no installer change needed.

extensions.name: Pedometer
extensions.description: Counts your steps with the motion sensor and shows them on their own screen, with a 10,000-step goal bar.

extensions.name: Metronome
extensions.description: A metronome in Settings (30 to 240 BPM). It also installs a working buzzer driver in place of the disabled one.
